_note: DP-LoRA v2 (2026-10-21): the strongest fair version of the DP fine-tuning baseline, every choice made on Jakarta only (composite vs train + Markov next-POI MRR on the Jakarta test split; runs in $TRAJPE_WORK/runs/baselines_v2/dplora/_tune/jakarta_v2). v1 (frozen.json) stays reproducible: each v2 change is a flag whose default is the v1 behaviour. Training hyper-parameters (batch, epochs, lr, rank, clip) are the v1 Jakarta-tuned ones. Grid jobs: jobs.py v2 (pipeline.py flags are built from 'format', 'train_v2', 'sample_v2', 'vp_ground_v2' (vp only) and models[...].pipeline).

_changes.a_format: 4-decimal coordinates (textfmt decimals=4). Real Jakarta trails through text + nearest-venue grounding keep 51.2% of exact venues with 3 decimals vs 94.2% with 4; Markov MRR ceiling 0.0430 (3 dec) vs 0.1190 (4 dec), real 50k 0.1319.
_changes.b_decoding: per-line repair (sample_vllm.py --decode repair): a malformed / out-of-list-category line is dropped instead of the whole trail. Chosen over constrained decoding (--decode constrained: vLLM structured outputs, textfmt.ebnf over the public category list) and v1 whole-trail rejection by TrajPE's rule (max Jakarta Markov MRR s.t. composite <= best + 0.03); see 'jakarta_selection'.
_changes.c_sampling: temperature 1, top-p 1 (swept on Jakarta: top-p 0.95/0.9 and temperature 0.9/1.1 all cost 0.07-0.44 composite with no MRR gain).
_changes.d_model: train.py / sample_vllm.py / sample.py --model, train.py --grad_ckpt (reentrant checkpointing under Opacus; test_dp.py (e)). Model entries below.
_changes.e_eps_inf: train.py --inf_steps nref (T = round(epochs * N_REF / batch) = the Jakarta-tuned 2,334 steps in every city) and --inf_clip 1.0 (global gradient-norm clipping).
_changes.f_accounting: pld_check.py composes the prior's Gaussians for vp sidecars and checks the release gates; ground.py refuses a train.json with oom_retries != 0 or complete == false.
_changes.g_vp_grounding: dploravp grounding scale (ground.py --ground_scale_km / --pop_radius_km; TrajPE's Grounder defaults 0.5 km / 1 km were made for imprecise coordinates): chosen per eps by TrajPE's rule on re-groundings of the same DP texts (post-processing).

7b.cap_note: uncapped 7B DP-SGD processes reserve 32-35 GB (peak allocated 21.7 GB); cap 30 GiB leaves room for allocator fragmentation (an OOM retry makes ground.py refuse the release) and fits two 7B jobs per H100 (94 GB), not three; vLLM sampling of 7B takes ~25 GB (14.3 weights + 8 KV + graphs)

jakarta_eps4.note: full Jakarta eps=4 run (219 steps) instead of a few-hundred-step probe; sec_per_step = lower-quartile window (GPU 1 shared with 0.5B eps=inf runs for the first ~40 min); peak = torch max allocated with gradient checkpointing and micro-batch budgets 4096 / 2048 tokens (memory only: the clipped sum does not depend on the split)
jakarta_eps4.projected_release_gpu_h_per_city: about 1.9 h at Jakarta size (9.5 M tokens); scale by jobs.py TOKENS_M (istanbul 15.2, tokyo 13.1, nyc 7.7, sao_paulo 7.2, kuwait_city 6.4)

1.5b.status: untested: weights not in $TRAJPE_WORK/hf_cache (train/sample run with HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1, download first); cost_factor interpolated by parameter count

3b.status: untested: weights not in $TRAJPE_WORK/hf_cache (train/sample run with HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1, download first); cost_factor interpolated by parameter count

jakarta._how: composite_vs_train (trajpe.metrics.composite_score, lower is better) and Markov next-POI MRR on the Jakarta test split (downstream/train_eval.py --model markov; run on GPU 1, equal to the CPU evaluator to 1e-8 on the v1 eps=4 release). v2 = the frozen v2 settings above; seed = sampling seed of the same trained adapter.

jakarta_selection.rule: TrajPE's: maximise Jakarta Markov MRR subject to composite <= best composite + 0.03 (per eps, over all candidates of that eps; the decoding/sampling choice made on plain is applied to vp, the vp grounding chosen on the vp texts)
jakarta_selection.decision: decode repair, temperature 1, top-p 1 at eps 4 and 1 (single-seed picks; also with the two-seed means: eps4 repair -2.008 / 0.0592 vs constrained -1.985 / 0.0588, eps1 repair -1.883 / 0.0472 vs constrained -1.858 / 0.0465; v1 rejection -1.975 / 0.0593 is outside the 0.03 band at eps4). Any top-p < 1 or temperature != 1 costs 0.07-0.44 composite (top-p truncates the digit distributions of times and coordinates). vp grounding scale 0.05 km (radius 1 km at eps4, 0.3 km at eps1; 0.01-0.02 km underflow in trajpe's Grounder).

recommended_model.rule: TrajPE's rule over the model sizes run on Jakarta (max Markov MRR s.t. composite <= best + 0.03); jobs.py v2 --model <key>; the grid default_model key only names the output dirs
